name: Zerath Wound Gate
abilities: Zerath Wound Gate: Final Name Cut
passives: Dominion Flame — Zerath's Mastery: Zerath's Dominion Flame: a solo hazard bloom that grows when the Titan uses chains, fire, and cursed ground to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Zerath Wound Gate is a colossal Infernal Dominion assassin from The Infernal Dominion. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Infernal Dominion assassin office: hidden name, silent verdict, secret execution; Horns/wings/claws: rank, predation, nobility, monstrous majesty.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Zerath Wound Gate shows black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.. Role silhouette must read as Assassin. Materials include black iron, volcanic glass, obsidian, blood wax, ash velvet, molten gold, charred parchment. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid red robot demon, generic Halloween devil, sci-fi cables, literal castle armor, block fortress body, cartoon pitchfork.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Zerath Execution Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal damage at range 1; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from burning terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Wound Shadow Pursuit
abilityDetails.effect: Apply mark, execute, teleport, priority burst; also builds 10 Dominion Heat when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate: Final Name Cut
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Dominion Heat to create a two-round battlefield rule around burning terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Wound Infernal Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Dominion Heat, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Dominion Wound Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +4 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Zerath Wound Gate Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +1 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Zerath Dominion Heat Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Dominion Heat cap +20. At 80+ Dominion Heat, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Dominion Heat.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: execute priority targets and reposition through danger
